_comment_live_trading_enabled: Master safety switch. Must be explicitly set to true for LIVE mode to place any real order. false (default) keeps LIVE fully paper-trade, same as before this feature existed.
_comment_target_exit: Which of Exit1-4 ALSO closes the real position for real, in addition to SL (SL is always a real exit regardless of this setting). One of: null, "exit1", "exit2", "exit3", "exit4". null means SL is the only real exit (current/paper-trade behavior).
